text: Euraxian Soldiers are generic Imperials standing guard in the city of Rimmen, Northern Elsweyr. They are in the employ of Euraxia Tharn, but have no unique dialogue.
Estayne Mouriou is a Breton Battlegrounds Furnisher residing in the Gladiator's Quarters outside of Solitude.
Eslyn is a Reachman women and the daughter of Chief Eagleseer, leader of Eagleseer Clan in .
Erinquen is an Altmer merchant found as a random encounter on the roads of Auridon. Robbing her is part of the achievement Crime Pays.
Evethra is a Dunmer in that is a part of the Saints & Seducers Creation Club content. She is encountered during the miscellaneous quest "Amber and Madness Smithing."
Erden Relvel is a Dunmer conjurer in that is a part of the Ghosts of the Tribunal Creation Club content.
Eydis Fire-Eye is a Nord Master-at-Arms. She is Guardian of the Fighters Guild in Balmora.

Faelian is an Altmer who resides in the Imperial City. He lives in the Tiber Septim Hotel in the Talos Plaza District with his girlfriend, Atraena. He often likes to take walks throughout the Imperial City and frequents Lorkmir's House. According to Atraena, Faelian used to be a fine gentleman until he began his addiction to skooma, which has torn their relationship apart.
Eyja is a Nord living in Skingrad. Eyja is also a servant for hire for 150 if the Hero has bought the Servants quarters in Rosethorn Hall.
Eydis is a Nord and the owner of Old Hroldan Inn. She is the mother of Skuli.
Faendal is a Bosmer archer found in Riverwood. He works for Gerdur and Hod and can often be found doing work around the mill in Riverwood.
Evilu Indrano is a Dunmer rogue in who resides in Shushan. She carries the Shushan Slave Key.
Fadren Dalis is a Dunmer warrior who resides in the Ministry of Truth.
Ezhmaar Sul was a male Dunmer, and one of the people directly responsible for the events of the Red Year. He is only called Ezhmaar Sul by his wife, Ilzheven, whereas everyone else calls him Sul.
Evoker Valinwe is an Altmer residing in Aldcroft, Glenumbra. She has a stand by the Mages Guild where she sells her wares.
Fadi is a Redguard member of the Hollow Moon residing in Redfur Trading Post in the region of Grahtwood.
Fabrice Menoit is a Breton member of the Mages Guild residing in Crosswych, Glenumbra. He works along with his wife, Petrille, in their shop Menoit's Emporium.
Fabia is an Imperial living at the Weynon Priory in Cyrodiil, east of Chorrol.
Faderi is a Dunmer farmer residing in Wayrest in Stormhaven. He has a few chickens he looks after and is very protective of them. He is located near the Chironasium.
Eydreigga is a Nord working at the dockyards in Davon's Watch.
Faeldal is a Bosmer fisherman residing in Mistral, on Khenarthi's Roost
Eyes-Like-Night is an Argonian residing in the Instruction Halls in Shad Astula.
Fada is a Khajiit member of the Mages Guild. She is found on Eyevea.
Fadama is a Khajiit bard performing inside the manor of Skywatch.
Fabrelle Ghiardelli is a Breton residing in the city of Wayrest.
Exarch Arnoth is a member of the Scaled Court, a cult worshipping the Celestial Serpent.

Exarch Braadoth, also known as the Ophidian Exarch of Undulating Destruction, is the Orsimer chieftain of the Iron Orcs. He resides within his stronghold. He is the author of several letters: *Exarch's Orders *Letter to Armorer Uthik *Letter to Runescriber Kulth
Eydvi Iron-Kettle is a Nord found in Mud Tree Village. She is married with Hodmar Iron-Kettle, before the events of Schism.
Eye-Fancy is a Khajiit bard performing in front of a small crowd in Mistral including Draugorin, Ahmuna-la, Oonama, and Shamara-ma.
Eyes-of-Steel is an Argonian soldier and member of the Great Moot, the ruling body of the Ebonheart Pact, during the Alliance War. She represents the Saxhleel race in the pact.
Eyes-the-Path is an Argonian elite gear vendor selling his wares at the Merchant House at the Northern Morrowind Gate.
Ezreba is a Khajiit residing in Greenhill. She was forced to help the Stonefire Cult with their plan to overtake the town after they captured her mate Hizurrdo.
Fa'alar is a Khajiit part of the gang found inside outlaws refuge underneath Elden Root.
Fabien is a Redguard found in Daggerfall. He can be seen talking to Damien. He cannot be interacted with.
Fada at-Glina is a Redguard found at the Rahni'Za, School of Warriors.
Fada-daro is a Khajiit merchant selling her wares in Longhaven.
Faedre is a Bosmer guild trader in selling her wares at The West Step Stalls in Daggerfall.

Faenir is a Bosmer member of Captain Linwen's crew, and is one of the few who remain loyal to it. She is also the wife of Captain Linwen, the former captain of the Albatross, and has been kidnapped and brought to the Cave of Broken Sails by the mutineers.
Faenir Blood-Letter is one of the three vampires responsible for the curse lingering in the Shademist Moors.
Fabremund Garnier is a Breton chef and member of the Lion Guard residing in the Bangkorai Garrison, Bangkorai. He sells his wares at his stall, the Conqueror's Kitchen.
Fabasi is a Khajiit enchanter. She sells her wares at her store, Fabasi's Runes & Enchantments, in Orsinium.
Fabrelle Marck is a Breton noble residing in the city of Orsinium. She is related to Gabria Marck.
Fa'ren-dar is a Khajiit smuggler and honorary member of the Thieves Guild. He is found inside the Thieves Den of Abah's Landing. He is known as the Master of Heists within the guild.
Eyes-In-Shadow is an Argonian member of the Ebonheart Pact. He guards their entrance to the Imperial City Sewers.
Eyes-Like-Water is an Argonian accompanying Captain One-Eye on her journey into Coldharbour.
Evrart Toillier is a Breton drunkard and patron of The Snakeskin Suds in Hallin's Stand, Bangkorai, in .
Evisi Arvu is a Dunmer member of the Ebonheart Pact. She is stationed in Fort Virak.
Evoker Ahainar-jo is a Khajiit member of the Mages Guild. He is part of Warlock Carindon's expedition into Selene's Web.
Evoker Neshtat is a Khajiit member of the Mages Guild. She is part of Warlock Carindon's expedition into Selene's Web.
Faedridil is a Bosmer laborer walking around Pilgrim's Approach in Vivec City. She has no unique dialogue.
Evos Hledas is a Dunmer found in the Saint Delyn Plaza on the upper level of the Canton of St. Delyn the Wise in Vivec City.
Fabremund Ragon is a Breton servant residing in the Saint Olms Waistworks in the Canton of St. Olms the Just in Vivec City. He has no unique dialogue.
Evylu Nethalen is a Dunmer mystic residing in Gnisis on Vvardenfell. She is located inside the Gnisis Temple.
Evo Hledas is a Dunmer member of the Clockwork Apostles found at the Clockwork Basilica in the Brass Fortress, Clockwork City.
Ezudiwa is a Khajiit servant and member of the Clockwork Apostles found at the Clockwork Basilica in the Brass Fortress, Clockwork City.

Factotum Harvesters are factotums that reside in the Everwound Wellspring. They are not hostile to the Vestige, and can be seen doing menial agricultural labor such as spreading seeds and transporting produce.

Factotum Sanitizers are characters that appears in . Factotum Sanitizers are Factotums commonly found in the Clockwork City. Sanitizers within the Brass Fortress are not hostile and can be pickpocketed, whereas those outside of the fortress are hostile. Sanitizers can be observed sweeping floors in interior areas.
Fabia Viria is an Imperial found in the Rimmen Outlaws Refuge in Rimmen, Northern Elsweyr. She has no unique dialogue.
Fabius Albus is an Imperial member of the Star-Gazers who can be found in the Sanctum Ophidia. He stands next to the apprehended Scaevola Calvisius.
Fadaz is a Redguard employee of Kasalla who serves as her bodyguard along with Zulee.

Examiner Beneran is a Dunmer researcher of the Mages Guild found in the Daedric Ruins of Ramimilk, Vvardenfell, in . He is examining the collected bones in the southeastern part of the ruin. He has no unique dialogue and cannot be interacted with.
Exarch Turvon is an Altmer vampire located in Grayhome, the former base of operations of the Gray Host, in .
Exarch Braxhard is a Nord vampire located in Grayhome, the former base of operations of the Gray Host, in .
Exarch Gazes-Red is an Argonian vampire located in Grayhome, the former base of operations of the Gray Host, in .
Exarch Nezbi is a Khajiit vampire located in Grayhome, the former base of operations of the Gray Host, in .
Exarch Uls Grimlantern is a Nord vampire located in Grayhome, the former base of operations of the Gray Host, in .
Exarch Vem is an Imperial vampire located in Grayhome, the former base of operations of the Gray Host, in .

Fargoth is a Bosmer Commoner living in the town of Seyda Neen. Because of the diminutive nature and size of his race, he is frequently shaken down by the Imperial Legion Watch Captain Hrisskar Flat-Foot, who likes to put his possessions in a barrel beside the door leading to the second building of the Census and Excise building.
The Falmer are creatures that appear in . They are a race of Mer formerly known as Snow Elves, who have devolved into primitive creatures inhabiting the dark underground and remote areas of Skyrim.
Falvel Arenim is a Dunmer savant residing in Balmora. He is also a member of House Hlaalu.
Faral Retheran is a Dunmer agent and member of House Redoran who resides in the Vivec, Redoran Canton.

Farangel Gardner was the Breton founder, and first King of Wayrest. He also founded the Gardner Dynasty in 1E 1100. Farangel built Farangel's Landing from where he sent his ships all over Tamriel to trade and export wares. He built the city of Wayrest from the ground up, and continued to found the Gardner Dynasty, which ended in the Second Era during the Interregnum as a result of the Knahaten Flu which whipped every remaining family member of the dynasty. He authored an unpublished series of poems which can be read in King Farangel's Ode to Wayrest.
Falanaamo is an Altmer clothier residing in the city of Caldera. He owns and operates a clothier there.
Fanar Fork-Beard is a Nord acrobat residing in the town of Dagon Fel. He owns a tiny shack on the waterfront.

Falvis Tunel is a Dunmer drillmaster in Hla Oad, Morrowind. He can be found in the caverns beneath Fatleg's Drop Off, among the slavers and smugglers. Falvis is not involved in any quests and does not offer any services.
Fanisea Irano is a Dunmer farmer residing in Vos, on the east coast of Vvardenfell. She can be found in her farmhouse.
Falanu Hlaalu is the owner of the shop All Things Alchemical in Skingrad and a member of the House Hlaalu of Morrowind. She says that she fled and is unable to return home.

Amiable Fanriene is a citizen of Bliss that has been "blessed" with paranoia; he cannot sleep in his own home for fear that the walls will close in and fall on him, ending his life. He seeks a safe place to sleep.
Fanildil is an Altmer healer living in Ebonheart, Hawkmoth Legion Garrison. He is also a member of the Imperial Legion.
Fainertil is an Altmer warrior and a member of the Fighters Guild in who resides in Ebonheart.

Fallaise is an Imperial Glenmoril Wyrd witch who resides in the Gloomy Cave in Solstheim. Fallaise and her two sisters, Ettiene and Isobel, have traveled from High Rock to Solstheim to help those with the lycanthropy disease.
Fafnir is a Nord Assassin in the Dark Brotherhood. He is the Dark Brotherhood liaison for the quest "Whodunit?."
Fammana is an Imperial vampire who resides in Galom Daeus with the rest of the Clan Berne. She is found in the observatory with Reberio.

Farengar Secret-Fire, commonly referred to throughout the game as Farengar, serves as the court wizard for Jarl Balgruuf the Greater at Dragonsreach in Whiterun where he conducts studies regarding magic and dragons.
Faralda is an Altmer mage who teaches Destruction at the College of Winterhold and guards the college's bridge. Her chamber is in the Hall of Countenance.
Falk Firebeard is a Nord steward serving and advising Jarl Elisif the Fair of Solitude. His duties keep him in the Blue Palace.
Faleen is a Redguard warrior residing at Understone Keep in Markarth, where she serves as the housecarl to Jarl Igmund.
Faida is a Nord innkeeper, merchant, and the owner of the Four Shields Tavern in Dragon Bridge. She teaches the hostelry trade to Julienne Lylvieve.

The Falmer Servants are enslaved citizens of Skyrim that the Falmer have captured and forced to fight for their bidding. Not much is known about them but they are confirmed to consist of Nords, Bretons, Orsimer, Khajiit, Redguards, Bosmer, and Dunmer. They can be found in Blackreach and have barracks with stone beds for sleeping in the Hall of Rumination near the Silent City Catacombs. It is impossible to liberate them, as they seem to be completely loyal to their Falmer masters. They can be briefly spoken to if sneaked up to, then become aggressive.

Falmer Skulkers are a type of falmer in . The sixth strongest type of Falmer, Skulkers are found in Dwemer Ruins and caves, usually assisted by a few normal Falmer or fighting alongside higher-level Falmer such as Gloomlurkers or Falmer Nightprowlers. Although they don't wear much armor, they have larger health pools than normal Falmer and can cast spells such as Ice Spike and Sparks, which can quickly slow down and overpower the Dragonborn in close quarters. Therefore, it is best to take Skulkers out from a distance before they can close in.
Far-Sighted Uche was an Atmoran warrior who lived during the Merethic Era. He was one of the Five Hundred Companions.
Falanu Indaren is a Dunmer commoner who resides near Ald'ruhn. She became separated from her husband Drerel when they encountered a group of nix-hounds.
Falso Sadrys is a Dunmer commoner and member of House Hlaalu, who resides in the Vivec, St. Olms Canton.
Falena Hlaren is a Dunmer bard living in Fara's Hole in the Wall, in Sadrith Mora.
Fanuse Farano is a Dunmer warrior residing in the cave of Punammu.
Farena Arelas is a Dunmer mage who may be found at Arelas' House in Tel Uvirith.
The Falmer Shadowmaster is a type of Falmer found in Skyrim.
Falura Llervu is a Dunmer Slave. She can be purchased in Tel Aruhn from Savile Imayn.
Faldan is a Bosmer archer, and member of House Telvanni who resides in the Tel Naga tower in Sadrith Mora.
Fara is a Bosmer publican residing in the town of Sadrith Mora. She owns and operates the inn Fara's Hole in the Wall, and also provides training in the Sneak, Light Armor and Acrobatics skills.

Fanari Strong-Voice is the leader of the Skaal Village in Solstheim. She was chosen to become leader after her predecessor, Skaf the Giant, died. She reveals her name alludes to her always speaking her mind.
Fallaise is a hagraven in . She is the sister of Ettiene and Isobel.

Faire Agarwen was a Snow Elf who lived during the Merethic Era. She was able to survive the war between the Atmorans—and, later, the early Nords—fought against the Snow Elves. However, it is unknown whether or not she survived the continued mass genocide of the Snow Elves. During the war, she wrote a diary about her experiences, noting her recollections about what it was like when there was peace between the Snow Elves and the Nords, and how the Snow Elves will never be the same again due to the devastation the Atmorans unleashed upon the Elves.
Faric Panoit is a Breton healer residing in the tower of Hanud. He is a hireling of House Telvanni, and will attack the Nerevarine on sight, even if they are a fellow member.
Fahara'jad is the Redguard Forebear King of Sentinel and High King of Hammerfell. He is responsible for the Redguard's joining the Daggerfall Covenant.
Fahamal is a Redguard merchant residing in the region of Glenumbra.
Falindil is an Altmer clothier residing in the city of Port Hunding, Stros M'Kai. He can be found selling his wares at his shop, The Plait and Placket, at the local marketplace
Falarel is an Altmer musician found in the market of Daggerfall.
Fairwen is an Altmer and a Mages Guild teacher located in the Mages Guildhall in Vulkhel Guard.
Fanadis is a Bosmer residing in Elden Root in the region of Grahtwood.
Fahurr is a Khajiit magus and a member of the Mages Guild. He is found at their branch in Aldcroft.
Famronion is a Bosmer leatherworker residing in Woodhearth in the region of Greenshade. He is found in his store "The Greenbower."
Falahawn is a Bosmer residing in Elden Root in the region of Grahtwood.
Fanyarel is an Altmer residing in the Elden Root in the region of Grahtwood. He's a member of the Mages Guild.
Fanayell is a Bosmer merchant residing in Redfur Trading Post in the region of Grahtwood.
Falicia is a Bosmer in . She runs the shop at the Mages Guild.
Fararilde is an Altmer residing on Khenarthi's Roost, in Mistral
Fainorume is an Altmer residing in the city of Dawnbreak, in Auridon.
Falen Gilenim is a Dunmer residing in the Banking District of Mournhold.
Falseth Betharvel is a Dunmer found outside the Tribunal Temple in Mournhold.
Farcaano is an Altmer alchemist and member of the Mages Guild residing in the guilhall in Marbruk. He is the owner of Farcaano's Rare Reagents and Faarcano's Tasteful Tints.
Fangilmir is a Bosmer residing in the Shrouded Vale, in the region of Greenshade.
Fahad is a Redguard clothier residing in the city of Sentinel. He can be found selling his merchandise at Onsi's Aegis.
Fangil is a Bosmer member of the Aldmeri Dominion residing in the Western Elsweyr Gate in Cyrodiil.
Farideh is a Redguard residing in the city of Bergama, Alik'r.
Falthalorn is a Bosmer residing in the Rawl'kha Outlaws Refuge.
Faribah is a Redguard noble reading outside the Temple Canton in Vivec City. She offers no unique dialogue.
Falisa af-Armin is a Redguard residing in the city of Sentinel.
Farida Censoria is an Imperial residing in the city of Sentinel.
Falwyn Stonewalker is a Nord found at The Adept's Retreat in Windhelm.
Fargurd is a Nord bard residing in the city of Windhelm, playing near The Adept's Retreat. He has no unique dialogue.
Fairencarne is an Altmer found in the Shattered Grove. Initially found petrified by Merormo and is restored during the quest A Village Awakened.
Faladil is an Altmer who resides in the town of Silsailen, on the island of Auridon.
Falaki is a Nord member of the Fighters Guild. She is found at their guildhall in Riften.
Faled the Cook is a Nord cooking for the miners working the Lost Knife Cave.
Falice Menoit is a Breton member of the Spirit Wardens trying to help her fellow wounded wardens recover from the recent Midnight Union attack on the Pariah Abbey.
Falisse Dechery is a Breton priest found at the Daggerfall Cathedral.
Falora Rethan is a Dunmer banker and the proprietor of Rethan Holdings in Riften.
Falphirion is a Bosmer who has been kidnapped by the Drublog Clan members living in the Bloodtoil Valley.
Famazar is a Khajiit soul shriven residing in The Wretched Squalor, a shantytown at the foot of the Castle of the Worm.
Famdii is a Dunmer in who resides at the Bal Foyen Dockyards.
Fangoz is an Orsimer bandit and an associate of the local reaver Dugan the Red. Fangoz may be found at his camp, Dugan's Knoll.
Farandare is an Altmer scholar found at the Falinesti Spring Site in Malabal Tor. She is currently looking for her husband, who disappeared along with the city of Falinesti.
Farandor is a Bosmer found in the grove of Valeguard, Malabal Tor.
Fardel is a deceased Bosmer whose body is located in The Vile Manse, Reaper's March.
Farenlith is a Bosmer part of the group of outlaws found beneath Velyn Harbor. She has no unique dialogue.
Faradan is a Bosmer mage found sitting near the Shadehome Inn in Riften.
Farasad is a Redguard found in The Diamond Thimble in the Bazaar District of Abah's Landing, Hew's Bane. He is impossible to interact with.
Fahrzuzh is a character residing in the Hubalajad Palace in the city of Abah's Landing, Hew's Bane.
Falleh is a character found in the Hubalajad Palace in the city of Abah's Landing, Hew's Bane. She can be seen talking to Nabdanir and Nebuin, but is impossible to be interacted with.
Fahana is a Khajiit found wandering the streets of Anvil, Gold Coast.
Faltonia Lerus is an Imperial residing inside her house in Anvil. She cannot be interacted with.
Falx Brolus is an Imperial found sweeping the road just outside the northern gates of Anvil, Gold Coast.
Fangs-Like-Ice is a male Argonian residing at the Northern Morrowind Gate, in Cyrodiil.
Far-From-Water is an Argonian residing at the Baandari Trading Post.
Faninmandon is a Bosmer Noble residing in Woodhearth. He is also a potential assassination target.
Faral Gilaram is a Dunmer student in who resides at Ladrasa's House in Dhalmora.
Faras Dralas is a Dunmer residing in Bleakrock Village. She is an alchemist-class character, however offers no wares, or unique dialogue.
Fahrazadar is a Redguard sailor residing in Abah's Landing, located in the resident Mages Guild branch.
Faras Givyn is a Dunmer and mother to Llonas Givyn residing in Sadrith Mora.
Faric Dral is a Dunmer thief residing in the Saint Delyn Waistworks of Vivec City. She offers no unique dialogue.
Fanisea Saram is a Dunmer in Vvardenfell. She is a wandering merchant, and can be found on the roads between Gnisis and Balmora, along with her pack guar, Peony.

Falura Uveleth is a Dunmer located in a camp outside of Zainsipilu, in Vvardenfell, and farmhand to Halinjirr. She is a former officer of House Redoran's Narcotics Oath-Bureau, whose career went downhill after she became addicted to skooma on her undercover mission.
Fancy Nuzbawir is a Redguard residing in the outlaws refuge beneath the city of Orsinium, Wrothgar.

Fanasa Baro is a Dunmer residing in Mother's Den, a sublocation of the Shimmerene Waterworks underneath the city of Shimmerene, Summerset. She is an Apraxic Elf, having been exiled from Altmeri society.
Faldaleb is a Bosmer residing in the northwestern corner of the city of Shimmerene, Summerset, where he can be found playing a game with Baronas, Lugurzog, and Sorr. He has no unique dialogue.
Falordilmo is a traveling merchant who can be found travelling along the road from Sunhold Wayshrine to Prisoner's Hold with his companion, a flame atronach horse named Ember.
Famia Mercius is an Imperial member of the Cyrodilic Collections. She has a sister, Concordia Mercius.
Faldrin is a deceased Nord in / that is a part of the Creation Club addon Fishing.
Fallen Marksman is a Transmuted Marksman guarding The Fallen Foreman in .
Fallen Miner is a Transmuted Miner guarding The Fallen Foreman in .
Felas Sarandas was a Dunmer agent who lived near the end of the Third Era and at the beginning of the Fourth. He was extremely germophobic, not wanting anyone to breathe on him or touch him.
Ferrum is a Breton living in Cloud Ruler Temple, north of Bruma as a member of the Blades.
Ferdelus Wagariun was a citizen in the Imperial City, Cyrodiil, who was killed by Agarmir. Agarmir then used the items of clothing that she had on them to sell to Thoronir.
Farvam Faram is a Dunmer pilgrim in Molag Mar, Morrowind. He resides at the St. Veloth's Hostel atop the city. Farvam carries twenty , wields throwing knives, and is not involved in any quests.

Farusea Salas is a Dunmer commoner who resides in Pelagiad, Morrowind. She can be found wandering the area near her home, unarmed and wearing common clothing. Although the door to her house is locked she does not carry a key. Farusea is not involved in any quests.
Ferise Varo is a Dunmer mage living in Vos, Vvardenfell. She provides Mage Services.
Ferone Veran is a Dunmer ordinator residing on the lower level of Ghostgate's Tower of Dawn.
Fenas Madach is a Breton alchemist, and member of the Thieves Guild residing in the Madach Tradehouse in Gnisis.
Felen Relas is a Dunmer mage found at the Anvil Mages Guild. He is an Alchemy Trainer and sells Alchemy supplies, such as apparatūs, potions, ingredients, soul gems, and a few books.
Faustina Cartia is the leader of the Sirens, an all female gang of thieves that operates out of Anvil.

Fathis Aren is a Dunmer Mages Guild member who prefers to keep to himself. He resides in Fathis Aren's Tower south of Bravil. Fathis is an apprentice Conjuration trainer. He wears leveled plate mail (iron cuirass, steel cuirass, etc.), meaning heavy armor is one of his primary skills.

Farwil Indarys is a Dunmer warrior and the son of the Count of Cheydinhal. He was the leader of the Knights of the Thorn and believed his knights were capable of anything; therefore, when an Oblivion Gate opened up outside Cheydinhal, he and his knights rushed in to close it with heavy losses.
Ferul Ravel is a Dunmer savant and a devout follower of the Daedra Prince Sheogorath, having abandoned all traces of sanity in order to serve him more closely.
Faurinthil is a Bosmer commoner who has devoted her life to worshiping the Daedric prince Sanguine. Thus, she can be found at the Shrine of Sanguine, west of Skingrad.
Fentula Pevengius is an Imperial warrior who resides in the cave of Ahinipalit, which is located in the region of Molag Amur.

Felldir the Old was a Nordic hero who helped overthrow the Dragons during the Dragon War in the Merethic Era. He can be seen on the Throat of the World and in Sovngarde. He wears a Greybeard's Robe and uses an Ancient Nord Greatsword.
Fastred is a Nord in who lives with her parents in Ivarstead. She wishes nothing more than to follow her heart.
Faryl Atheron is a Dunmer farmer working at the Brandy-Mug Farm, just outside of Windhelm.
Felisa Ulessen is a Dunmer mage serving as Mouth for Therana. She can be found in the Telvanni Council House in Sadrith Mora and is a quest giver for House Telvanni.
Fathasa Llethri is a Dunmer who resides in Llethri Manor in Ald'ruhn.
Favel Gobor is a Dunmer rogue who resides in the Black Shalk Cornerclub, located in the Foreign Quarter Lower Waistworks within Vivec City. He is a member of House Hlaalu.
Favas Nilem is a Dunmer warrior who resides in the Ministry of Truth.
Favela Dralor is a Dunmer noble who resides in the Dralor Manor within the Vivec, Redoran Canton.
Faver Seran is a Dunmer who resides in a cave known as Milk in the West Gash region of Morrowind.
Favilea Sathendas is a Dunmer commoner who resides in Manor District of Ald'ruhn.

Faves Andas is a Dunmer who resides in Shishi, Morrowind. He can be found in a secret area of Shishi. He is a member of House Telvanni and is the only survivor of a Redoran attack on the newly formed Telvanni outpost.
Favise Selaren is a Dunmer noble who resides in the Vivec, Foreign Quarter Plaza in Vivec City.
Favona Gilnith is a Dunmer noble who resides in the Vivec, St. Olms Canton.
Fedris Tharen is a Dunmer pilgrim found outside Koal Cave. Tharen fell ill with the Chills disease and cannot make the journey back to Gnisis.
Fedura Sethan is a Dunmer commoner who can be found working at St. Olms Farmers and Laborers Hall alongside Gindas Ildram. She is most likely his servant.
Felara Andrethi is a Dunmer healer and merchant who resides in the Tel Aruhn Tower Living Quarters.
Felara Thimalvel is a Dunmer thief who resides in the cave of Ahinipalit, which is located in the region of Molag Amur.
Felayn Andral is a Dunmer enchanter who resides within the hallowed halls of Holamayan Monastery in Morrowind. He is a member of the Dissident Priests.
Feldrelo Sadri is a Dunmer monk and member of the Tribunal Temple who can be found at the Balmora Temple.
Felisi Serano is a Dunmer mage in residing in Ashalmawia east of Ald Velothi in the West Gash on Vvardenfell. He is hostile and will attack the Nerevarine on sight.
Felmena Falavel is a Dunmer ordinator and member of Tribunal Temple, who resides in the Vivec, Temple Canton inside the Justice Offices.
Felsa Hleran is a Dunmer nightblade residing in Sanabi. She is a Bandit.
Felsu Telas is a Dunmer thief and slaver residing in the stronghold of Hlormaren. She is found on the top level of the stronghold's keep.
Femer Veralor is a Dunmer found in . He is held captive in a prison cell inside the tower, that can be found in Vivec City's Telvanni Canton.
e Fendel Alam is a Dunmer bandit, and resides in the cave of Adanumuran.
Fendel Hlaren is a Dunmer noble and member of House Telvanni, who resides in the Vivec, Telvanni Canton.
Fendros Varys is a Dunmer rogue residing in the cave of Punammu.
Fendryn Delvi is a Dunmer gondolier who resides near the Telvanni Canton of Vivec City. He wears a gondolier shirt, a gondoiler's helm, a pair of common pants, and wields an iron dagger.
Ferele Athram is a Dunmer trader who resides in his shop in Tel Aruhn. He has 400 to trade with.
Feruren Oran is a Dunmer spellsword who resides in Vivec City. He can be found inside the Elven Nations Cornerclub in the Hlaalu Plaza. He is the target of the Morag Tong quest Writ for Feruren Oran.
Fervas Reloro is a hostile Dunmer thief and slaver, who resides in the slaver cave of Zainsipilu.
Fervsea Girothran is a Dunmer sorcerer residing in Odaishah.
Edd "Fast Eddie" Theman is a Dunmer Sorcerer. He resides in his house in north-central Balmora while "things cool off a bit in House Telvanni."
Faulgor is a Bosmer agent and member of House Hlaalu who resides in the Vivec, St. Olms Canton.
Fasile Charascel is a Breton scout and an apprentice with the Fighters Guild who can be found in the guild hall in Balmora.

Feran Sadri is a Dunmer vampire residing in Castle Volkihar. His wide upturned nose is distinctly bat-like. He serves as the castle alchemist and is willing to trade with the Dragonborn if the Volkihar clan is joined. However, if the Dragonborn joins the clan and is cured of vampirism afterwards, it will no longer be possible to trade with Feran or receive his quests unless the Dragonborn becomes a vampire again.

Commodore Fasil Umbranox was a Count of Anvil. He is an ancestor of Corvus Umbranox, the last known Gray Fox of the Thieves Guild in Cyrodiil, and had a strong rivalry with a pirate named Torradan ap Dugal.
Feril Salmyn was an ordinator whose corpse can be found at the Dunmer stronghold of Kogoruhn.
Faume Toad-Eye was a Bosmer king of Valenwood. He was the father of Oreyn Bearclaw, who grew up to be a hero by slaying the Glenhwyfaunva.
Fedris Hler is a Dunmer assassin who resides in the reception area of the Mournhold Temple in Mournhold.
Felvan Ienith is a Dunmer rogue who lives in the district of Godsreach, Mournhold.
Feranos Hlando is a Dunmer witchhunter who lives in the Secret Office, accessible through a locked door at the Craftsmen's Hall, in the district of Godsreach, Mournhold.

Feral Shrivens, also referred to as Feral Soul Shriven, are hostile characters located in The Wailing Prison. They are normal Soul Shriven who went feral after their torment, and attacking any Soul Shriven they see.
Fasele Viralaine is a Breton noble who resides in the Vivec, Hlaalu Canton. She can be encountered wandering around the topmost floor of the canton, Hlaalu Plaza.
Feduria Llaren is a Dunmer residing in Davon's Watch in Stonefalls. She is standing in front of Krastir's shop, War-Worthy Leathers, in the market.
Ferarilie Riscel is a Breton nightblade who resides in the Vivec, Telvanni Canton.

Fasion is an Altmer residing in the city of Vulkhel Guard in Auridon. He is found working to try and stop the Veiled Heritance plot against Queen Ayrenn. Watchman Heldil will try to convince the Vestige that Fasion is working against the Queen.
Fauril is a Bosmer residing in the city of Vulkhel Guard, Auridon.
Ferou Rouillac is a Breton who resides in The Rosy Lion inn in the city of Daggerfall, Glenumbra.
Feathers is a Khajiit residing in Redfur Trading Post in the region of Grahtwood.
Farwen is a Bosmer residing in the Greenshade town of Woodhearth. She has a house in her name.
Farona Telvanni is a Dunmer of House Telvanni and a member of the Mages Guild. She is found at their branch in Mournhold.
Felariel is a Bosmer clothier residing in the city of Mournhold, Deshaan. She can be found at the Artisans Craftworks, selling her wares.
Ferdyn Beran is a Dunmer student found in the Guild Plaza of Mournhold, located right outside of the city's resident Fighters Guild branch.
Fayagwen is a Bosmer residing in the Shrouded Vale, in the region of Greenshade.
Feldrasa is a Dunmer member of the Star-Gazers. She is found at their observatory in Belkarth.
Feristyr is an Imperial member of the Fighters Guild. He is found at their branch in Sentinel.
Fedrasa Andrethi is the Dunmer innkeeper and owner of The Ebony Flask in Ebonheart.
Feduzdal is a Khajiit brewer and slave. He works at The Sugar-Rot Slop House in the pens of Kragenmoor.
Felira is a Khajiit slave and a patron of The Sugar-Rot Slop House in the pens of Kragenmoor.
Farro is a Nord member of the Mages Guild. He is found on Eyevea.
Fedura is a Khajiit member of the Mages Guild. She is found on Eyevea.
Fervyn is a Dunmer residing in the Tal'Deic Fortress, Deshaan.
Felyx Vienne is a Breton grocer working at the Last Chance Station stall, within the Gateside Market in Dragonstar.
